english.title: Create/use/keep/process embryo without a licence or 3rd party agreement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[brought about the creation of an embryo other than in pursuance of a licence under Schedule 2 to the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990]_
(B)_[kept an embryo other than in pursuance of a licence under Schedule 2 to the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990]_
(C)_[used an embryo other than in pursuance of a licence under Schedule 2 to the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990]_
(D)_[kept, without storage, an embryo intended for human application other than in pursuance of a third party agreement]_
(E)_[processed, without storage, an embryo intended for human application other than in pursuance of a third party agreement]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 41(2)(a) and (4) of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravene s 3(1) or 3(1A)
otherwise than by doing something which
by virtue of s 3(3)
cannot be authorised by a licence

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) No proceedings for an offence under this Act shall be instituted in England and Wales, except by or with the consent of the DPP or in Northern Ireland, except by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions for Northern Ireland.
(ii) If the offence involves doing something which by virtue of section 3(3) cannot be authorised by a licence, the defendant MUST be prosecuted under section 41(1)(b)

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
